Incident Name: Rogue Devices Found in U.S. Solar Inverters
Verified Impact Summary: Security experts found rogue communication devices in solar power inverters and batteries installed across the United States. Undocumented devices could be used for data theft, electricity misuse, or as a platform for launching further cyber attacks.
Verification Status: Confirmed discovery; potential for future exploitation

Attack Type: Cyberattack / suspected ransomware against business IT systems of national oil pipeline operator
Attacker / Group: Qilin ransomware group claimed responsibility; Conpet did not initially confirm attacker
Verified Impact Summary: Conpet disclosed a cyberattack affecting business IT infrastructure and website availability. The company stated operational technologies, including SCADA and telecommunications systems, were not affected, and oil transport continued normally.
Verification Status: Confirmed energy-sector cyber incident; indirect IT-to-OT risk; no SCADA/pipeline-operation disruption confirmed
